create_auths_insert_new_auth: create a new user auth record with email, password, name, and optional role by calling Auths.insert_new_auth
authenticate_user_password: authenticate a user by email and password using Auths.authenticate_user with a verify_password callback
authenticate_user_api_key: authenticate a user by API key using Auths.authenticate_user_by_api_key
update_user_password: update a user's password by ID using Auths.update_user_password_by_id
delete_auth_by_id: delete a user auth and associated user record by ID using Auths.delete_auth_by_id
